reserveReview.rationale: The live single-asset adapter publishes one aggregate AUD bank deposits row, so the reviewed classification is keyed to that exact 100% identity. The June 30, 2026 reserve report preserves the underlying detail: AUD 2,076,942.59 of cash at Banking Circle and AUD 11,176,571.25 of cash at Westpac under the AMAL bare trust, for AUD 13,253,513.84 total reserves against AUD 13,038,732.34 on-chain (15.67% and 84.33% of the reserve). The report does not disclose deposit terms or deposit-insurance coverage.
